---
name: recruiter-optimization
description: Improve the portfolio for SAP ABAP recruiter scanning while preserving technical depth.
---

Review and improve the portfolio for SAP ABAP / S/4HANA recruiter readability. Preserve factual accuracy and technical depth. Do not invent experience, metrics, project counts, clients, responsibilities, certifications, or outcomes. Prefer concise role positioning, outcome-oriented verified responsibilities, and clear SAP keywords. Before making substantial content changes, show the proposed changes and ask for approval.
